prompts.B:
Use case: background-extraction with precise-object-edit for hidden regions.
Asset: B_full.png, a single transparent animation layer extracted from image 1.
Inputs: Image 1 crowd.png is the actual edit target (1671x941). Image 2 crowd_annotated.png is ONLY an identification guide, not the pixels to use.
Extract ONLY person B: the foreground dark man on the left with glasses, facing LEFT, head around x80-330,y195-490, body fills the lower-left to about x520 at the bottom. F is a DIFFERENT pale man facing right behind him, with face at x340-440. Do NOT merge F into B. Remove all other people including F and all remnants of the center silhouette.
Preserve B's existing head, glasses, left-facing profile, black jacket, white diagonal collar/shoulder rim and photographic coarse halftone grain exactly. Reconstruct only B's unseen contour where needed, as a natural dark coat. Shoulders/torso continue off the bottom canvas. No new legs, no posing changes.
Canvas MUST remain the original full 1671x941 landscape, with B in exactly his original position and size. His head top stays near y195 and x80; don't center or enlarge him. All other areas actually transparent RGBA; no checkerboard baked in, white backdrop, text, labels, blue or magenta, watermark, background haze, or shadows.
Pure black-and-white high contrast fine stippled halftone like source; preserve visible source regions rather than restyling them. No gray wash, smooth painting or new rim lighting. Original silhouette antialiasing only. Return one complete canvas, not a contact sheet.
prompts.D:

No legs added. Preserve photographic grain, do not smooth or redraw visible parts. Return one full canvas, not a contact sheet.
prompts.back:
Use case: precise-object-edit, reconstructing an occluded background crowd plate.
Asset: back_plate.png, transparent full canvas animation background plate, original 1671x941.
Inputs: image 1 crowd.png is edit target. Image 2 crowd_annotated.png labels people only: never copy annotations/colors.
Remove ONLY B (dark left-facing glasses man in foreground left) and D (large dark-haired bowed head in foreground right). Retain ONLY A (left edge sliver), F (pale right-facing profile previously behind B), C (back-turned man left of the center hole), E (bald lit head at far right). F is its OWN person separate from B. No extra people.
Keep every visible part of A/F/C/E exactly in source position, scale, pose and black/white photographic halftone texture. Reconstruct only their previously hidden head, neck, shoulder and dark coat regions uncovered by removal of B and D. F's head at x300-440,y190-470, C's head x485-695,y245-500, E's head x1435-1670,y175-510. Complete F left shoulder/body, C lower body behind B, E left shoulder/coat behind D; all bodies continue off lower frame. Keep the background above/between heads transparent; don't create a new continuous black rectangular background. Dark clothing may occupy the lower interior where those people actually extend.
Preserve the CENTRAL empty silhouette opening for the separately rendered binary man; do not add a new central person, head, outline, binary digits or color. Keep upper negative space transparent. The silhouette mask file itself is not being edited.
Exactly original full 1671x941 landscape canvas, no shifting/centering/cropping/resizing. True transparent alpha outside people; no annotation, checkerboard baked in, color, gray wash, smoothing, gradients, halo, or haze. Source visible black/white pixels must remain unchanged wherever possible. Output a single plate of these four people in original registration, not a collage.
